# Transfer Buffer

## $10\times$ Transfer Buffer ($1\ \mathrm{L}$)



| Ingredient | Concentration | Molecular weight | Amount |
|:---|---:|---:|---:|
| $\mathrm{Tris}$ | $250\ \mathrm{mM}$ | $121.136\ \mathrm{g/mol}$ | $30.28\ \mathrm{g}$ |
| $\mathrm{Glycine}$ | $1900\ \mathrm{mM}$ | $75.067\ \mathrm{g/mol}$ | $142.63\ \mathrm{g}$ |



- Add $20\%$ methanol fresh when preparing $1\times$ transfer buffer; do not add methanol to the $10\times$ stock.
- For proteins larger than $80\ \mathrm{kDa}$, add $0.1\%$ SDS.

To prepare $1\ \mathrm{L}$ of $1\times$ transfer buffer:

- $700\ \mathrm{mL}$ di$\mathrm{H_2O}$
- $100\ \mathrm{mL}$ $10\times$ transfer buffer
- $200\ \mathrm{mL}$ methanol


# Native Buffer

## $10\times$ Native Buffer ($1\ \mathrm{L}$)



| Ingredient | Molecular weight | Concentration | Amount |
|:---|---:|---:|---:|
| $\mathrm{NaH_2PO_4}$ | $119.98\ \mathrm{g/mol}$ | $500\ \mathrm{mM}$ | $60.0\ \mathrm{g}$ |
| $\mathrm{NaCl}$ | $58.44\ \mathrm{g/mol}$ | $5\ \mathrm{M}$ | $292.2\ \mathrm{g}$ |



Adjust to $\mathrm{pH}\ 8.0$ and bring the final volume to $1\ \mathrm{L}$.

## $5\times$ Native Buffer ($1\ \mathrm{L}$)



| Ingredient | Molecular weight | Concentration | Amount |
|:---|---:|---:|---:|
| $\mathrm{NaH_2PO_4}$ | $119.98\ \mathrm{g/mol}$ | $250\ \mathrm{mM}$ | $30.0\ \mathrm{g}$ |
| $\mathrm{NaCl}$ | $58.44\ \mathrm{g/mol}$ | $2.5\ \mathrm{M}$ | $146.1\ \mathrm{g}$ |



Adjust to $\mathrm{pH}\ 8.0$ and bring the final volume to $1\ \mathrm{L}$.

# TBST Buffer

## $10\times$ TBS ($1\ \mathrm{L}$)



| Ingredient | Concentration | Molecular weight | Amount |
|:---|---:|---:|---:|
| $\mathrm{Tris}$, $\mathrm{pH}\ 7.5$ | $200\ \mathrm{mM}$ | $121.136\ \mathrm{g/mol}$ | $24.24\ \mathrm{g}$ |
| $\mathrm{NaCl}$ | $1500\ \mathrm{mM}$ | $58.44\ \mathrm{g/mol}$ | $87.66\ \mathrm{g}$ |



Add Tween 20 fresh when preparing $1\times$ TBST; ***do not add it to the $10\times$ stock ("TBS buffer").***

To prepare $1\ \mathrm{L}$ of $1\times$ TBST:

- $100\ \mathrm{mL}$ $10\times$ TBS
- $899\ \mathrm{mL}$ di$\mathrm{H_2O}$
- $1\ \mathrm{mL}$ Tween 20

# Blocking Buffer

- $5\%$ nonfat milk

***OR***

- $1\%$ BSA

# PBS

## $10\times$ PBS ($1\ \mathrm{L}$)



| Ingredient | Amount |
|:---|---:|
| ${Na_2HPO_4}$ | $14.4\ \mathrm{g}$ |
| ${KH_2PO_4}$ | $2.4\ \mathrm{g}$ |
| ${NaCl}$ | $80\ \mathrm{g}$ |
| ${KCl}$ | $2\ \mathrm{g}$ |



Adjust to $\mathrm{pH}\ 7.4$ and bring the final volume to $1\ \mathrm{L}$.

## $10\times$ PBS ($500\ \mathrm{mL}$)



| Ingredient | Amount |
|:---|---:|
| $\mathrm{Na_2HPO_4}$ | $7.2\ \mathrm{g}$ |
| $\mathrm{KH_2PO_4}$ | $1.2\ \mathrm{g}$ |
| $\mathrm{NaCl}$ | $40\ \mathrm{g}$ |
| $\mathrm{KCl}$ | $1\ \mathrm{g}$ |



Adjust to $\mathrm{pH}\ 7.4$ and bring the final volume to $500\ \mathrm{mL}$.

# SDS Loading Dye


## $6\times$ Loading Buffer ($15\ \mathrm{mL}$)



| Reagent | Final concentration | Amount |
|:---|---:|---:|
| $\mathrm{Tris}$, $\mathrm{pH}\ 6.8$ | $375\ \mathrm{mM}$ | $1.875\ \mathrm{mL}$ |
| $\mathrm{SDS}$ | $6\%$ | $0.9\ \mathrm{g}$ |
| $\mathrm{Glycerol}$ | $60\%$ | $9\ \mathrm{mL}$ |
| $\mathrm{Bromophenol\ blue}$ | $0.12\%$ | $0.018\ \mathrm{g}$ |
| $\beta$-mercaptoethanol | $30\%$ | $4.5\ \mathrm{mL}$ |



## $5\times$ Loading Buffer ($15\ \mathrm{mL}$)



| Reagent | Stock concentration | Amount |
|:---|---:|---:|
| $\mathrm{Tris}$, $\mathrm{pH}\ 6.8$ | $1\ \mathrm{M}$ | $3.75\ \mathrm{mL}$ |
| $\mathrm{SDS}$ | $20\%$ | $3.00\ \mathrm{mL}$ |
| $\mathrm{Glycerol}$ | — | $4.50\ \mathrm{mL}$ |
| $\mathrm{Bromophenol\ blue}$ | — | $9\ \mathrm{mg}$ |
| $\beta$-mercaptoethanol | — | $2.40\ \mathrm{mL}$ |
| di$\mathrm{H_2O}$ or Milli-Q $\mathrm{H_2O}$ | — | $1.35\ \mathrm{mL}$ |



The calculated reagent volume is $6.75 + 4.50 + 2.40 = 13.65\ \mathrm{mL}$;

Leaving approximately $1.35\ \mathrm{mL}$ $\mathrm{H_2O}$ to reach $15\ \mathrm{mL}$.

# SDS Running Buffer

## $10\times$ SDS Running Buffer ($1\ \mathrm{L}$)



| Ingredient | Concentration | Molecular weight | Amount |
|:---|---:|---:|---:|
| $\mathrm{Tris}$ | $250\ \mathrm{mM}$ | $121.4\ \mathrm{g/mol}$ | $30.2\ \mathrm{g}$ |
| $\mathrm{Glycine}$ | $1920\ \mathrm{mM}$ | $75.066\ \mathrm{g/mol}$ | $144.1\ \mathrm{g}$ |
| $\mathrm{SDS}$ | $1\%$ | — | $10\ \mathrm{g}$ |



Dissolve the ingredients and bring the final volume to $1\ \mathrm{L}$.

- Tris rounded to $30\ \mathrm{g}$.
- Glycine rounded to $144\ \mathrm{g}$.
- SDS: $10\ \mathrm{g}$.
- $20\%$ SDS solution: $10\ \mathrm{g} = 50\ \mathrm{mL}$.

# Coomassie Stain

- $50\%$ methanol
- $0.1\%$ Coomassie blue
- $10\%$ glacial acetic acid
- Bring to the final volume with $\mathrm{H_2O}$.

## $500\ \mathrm{mL}$ Preparation



| Reagent | Amount |
|:---|---:|
| $\mathrm{Methanol}$ | $250\ \mathrm{mL}$ |
| $\mathrm{Coomassie\ blue}$ | $0.5\ \mathrm{g}$ |
| $\mathrm{Glacial\ acetic\ acid}$ | $50\ \mathrm{mL}$ |
| $\mathrm{H_2O}$ | $200\ \mathrm{mL}$ |



# Destaining Buffer

- $10\%$ ethanol
- $10\%$ glacial acetic acid
- Bring to the final volume with $\mathrm{H_2O}$.

## $500\ \mathrm{mL}$ Preparation



| Reagent | Amount |
|:---|---:|
| $\mathrm{Ethanol}$ | $50\ \mathrm{mL}$ |
| $\mathrm{Glacial\ acetic\ acid}$ | $50\ \mathrm{mL}$ |
| $\mathrm{H_2O}$ | $400\ \mathrm{mL}$ |



# Acetic Acid for Gel Storage

Use $5\%$ acetic acid to store SDS gels.

# SDS-PAGE Gel Tris Solutions



| Reagent | Concentration | Molecular weight | Amount for $1\ \mathrm{L}$ |
|:---|---:|---:|---:|
| $\mathrm{Tris}$, $\mathrm{pH}\ 8.8$ | $1.5\ \mathrm{M}$ | $121.14\ \mathrm{g/mol}$ | $181.71\ \mathrm{g}$ |
| $\mathrm{Tris}$, $\mathrm{pH}\ 6.8$ | $1\ \mathrm{M}$ | $121.14\ \mathrm{g/mol}$ | $121.14\ \mathrm{g}$ |



- For $1.5\ \mathrm{M}$ Tris, $\mathrm{pH}\ 8.8$: $18.171\ \mathrm{g}/100\ \mathrm{mL}$ or $90.855\ \mathrm{g}/500\ \mathrm{mL}$.
- For $1\ \mathrm{M}$ Tris, $\mathrm{pH}\ 6.8$: $12.114\ \mathrm{g}/100\ \mathrm{mL}$ dd$\mathrm{H_2O}$.

# Ammonium Persulfate

Prepare $10\%$ ammonium persulfate (APS) by dissolving $0.1\ \mathrm{g}$ APS in $1.0\ \mathrm{mL}$ $\mathrm{H_2O}$.

# BSA Solutions

- BSA for DARTS: $0.5\ \mathrm{\mu g/mL}$
- BSA for PGRN: $100\ \mathrm{mg/mL}$
- Prepare $20\ \mathrm{\mu L}$ aliquots for each loading or use.

# Ponceau S Stain

- $0.2\%\ \mathrm{w/v}$ Ponceau S
- $5\ \mathrm{mL}$ glacial acetic acid
- Bring to the intended final volume with $\mathrm{H_2O}$.

Note: "$50\ \mathrm{mM}$ $\mathrm{NaOH}$ (around 5 pills; $40\ \mathrm{g/mol}$), $1\ \mathrm{g}/500\ \mathrm{mL}$."

# PGRN Imidazole Buffer

## $3\ \mathrm{M}$ Imidazole Buffer, $\mathrm{pH}\ 6.0$ ($100\ \mathrm{mL}$)

Final composition:

- $3\ \mathrm{M}$ imidazole
- $500\ \mathrm{mM}$ $\mathrm{NaCl}$
- $20\ \mathrm{mM}$ sodium phosphate buffer, $\mathrm{pH}\ 6.0$

Preparation:

1. Add $20.6\ \mathrm{g}$ imidazole, $8.77\ \mathrm{mL}$ Stock Solution A ($10\times$), and $1.23\ \mathrm{mL}$ Stock Solution B ($10\times$) to approximately $80\ \mathrm{mL}$ di$\mathrm{H_2O}$.
2. Mix thoroughly and adjust to $\mathrm{pH}\ 6.0$ with $\mathrm{HCl}$ or $\mathrm{NaOH}$ as necessary.
3. Bring the final volume to $100\ \mathrm{mL}$ with di$\mathrm{H_2O}$.
4. If a precipitate forms, heat the solution until it dissolves.
5. Store at room temperature.

## Stock Solution A ($10\times$; $1\ \mathrm{L}$)

Final composition:

- $200\ \mathrm{mM}$ sodium phosphate, monobasic ($\mathrm{NaH_2PO_4}$)
- $5\ \mathrm{M}$ $\mathrm{NaCl}$

Preparation:

1. Dissolve $27.6\ \mathrm{g}$ monobasic sodium phosphate and $292.9\ \mathrm{g}$ $\mathrm{NaCl}$ in $800\ \mathrm{mL}$ di$\mathrm{H_2O}$.
2. Mix thoroughly and bring the final volume to $1\ \mathrm{L}$ with di$\mathrm{H_2O}$.
3. Store at room temperature.

## Stock Solution B ($10\times$; $1\ \mathrm{L}$)

Final composition:

- $200\ \mathrm{mM}$ sodium phosphate, dibasic ($\mathrm{Na_2HPO_4}$)
- $5\ \mathrm{M}$ $\mathrm{NaCl}$

Preparation:

1. Dissolve $28.4\ \mathrm{g}$ dibasic sodium phosphate and $292.9\ \mathrm{g}$ $\mathrm{NaCl}$ in $800\ \mathrm{mL}$ di$\mathrm{H_2O}$.
2. Mix thoroughly and bring the final volume to $1\ \mathrm{L}$ with di$\mathrm{H_2O}$.
3. Store at room temperature.

# Additional $5\times$ Loading Dye Note

- $10\%$ SDS
- $20\%$ glycerol
- $0.2\ \mathrm{M}$ Tris, $\mathrm{pH}\ 6.8$
- $0.1\%$ bromophenol blue
- $10\%$ $\beta$-mercaptoethanol
